call_points.text: Data centres were 30-35% of FY26 domestic Powergen revenue and about 35% in Q4.
Colocation inquiry velocity picked up sharply since October last year; hyperscalers also building in India.
Commodity inflation is being passed on with a lag; DEF is a small part of distribution.
Railways and mining order books building; construction moderate and compressors entering a down-cycle.
Exports: Europe and Asia Pac growing modestly, Middle East not growing as much; outlook unchanged.
BESS has strong inquiries but no local supply chain and no contribution guidance yet.
Lower-range CPCB IV+ demand is more elastic to commodity and inflation than project-based high horsepower.
Management declined to quantify data-centre aftermarket revenue or imported-engine lead times.

operating_notes.text: Cummins India recommended a final dividend of ₹46 per share for FY25-26.
FY26 standalone domestic sales ₹9,961 Cr (+19%) and exports ₹1,989 Cr (+12%).
Q4FY26 standalone domestic sales ₹2,513 Cr (+30% YoY) and exports ₹450 Cr (-6% YoY).
Data centres were 30-35% of FY26 domestic Powergen revenue and about 35% in Q4FY26.
Overall capacity utilisation is around 70%; over ₹1,000 Cr invested in the last five years with no major new capex plan.
Data-centre genset orders typically come 6-12 months before site readiness; high-horsepower portfolio lead time is 3-6 months.
Data centres were 40% of power generation revenue in Q1FY27 versus 23% in Q1FY26.
Utilisation is 70-75%; the India market is still largely QSK60, with QSK78 and QSK95 capacity not yet needed.
Distribution has 3,500 trained engineers and 450 touchpoints, with a 2-hour service guarantee for critical customers.

timeline.summary: Cummins India disclosed the proceedings of its postal ballot for managerial remuneration on April 21, 2026.
Cummins India Limited’s postal ballot resolutions passed via remote e-voting (March 22–April 20, 2026) with requisite majority, as certified by Scrutinizer Ashwini Inamdar.
Cummins Inc. (PAN: AABCC6225D) declared no encumbrance on Cummins India Limited shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Cummins India Limited’s **Ms. Shveta Arya (MD)** and management will host a Q4 & FY2025-26 results conference call for investors/analysts on **May 29, 2026, at 10:00 AM IST** via dial-in.

Cummins India Limited scheduled in-person investor conferences with ONE WAM Limited (May 29), BofA Securities India Ltd. (June 3), and Citigroup Global Markets India Private Limited (June 4) under Vinaya A. Joshi.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,011.18 Cr, net profit ₹649.46 Cr (+22.7% YoY).
Cummins India reported FY26 standalone sales of ₹11,950 Cr (+18% YoY) and PAT of ₹2,330 Cr (+22%), with Q4 sales of ₹2,963 Cr (+23% YoY) and Q4 exports down 6%.
Cummins India Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Q4 and FY2025-26 Results Conference Call held on May 29, 2026, at its investor website.
Cummins India's Q4/FY26 call transcript (held May 29, 2026) guided FY27 to "moderate growth", with data centres at 30-35% of FY26 domestic Powergen revenue and utilisation around 70%.
Cummins India Limited’s management will meet Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd, HDFC Securities Ltd, and others on June 12–15, 2026, for plant visits and equity conferences.
Q1FY27 (Aug 2026): Sales rose 18% YoY to ₹3,375 Cr; a quarterly high; but PBT before exceptionals fell 0.7% as commodity and freight costs rose
Cummins India Limited held a postal ballot to approve payment of commission to non‑executive independent directors, effective 15 October 2026.

watchlist.response: Said it will improve margins but would not commit to historic highs given unprecedented commodity and inflation.

watchlist.response: Attributed to a higher base and parts availability disruption; expects 20% growth over this year and the next few years.

watchlist.response: Said no syndicated market research exists, so market share cannot be shared.
